note: Flux-averaged differential cross sections and a per-bin flux-integrated cross section σ(Eν) for the semi-exclusive channel νμ + CH → μ⁻ + π⁰ + nucleon(s) (CC π⁰ production), measured by MINERvA in the low-energy NuMI νμ beam (spectral peak ≈3 GeV). Distributions: muon momentum pμ, muon angle θμ, π⁰ kinetic energy Tπ, π⁰ angle θπ, cross section vs Eν (1.5–20 GeV), Q² (full sample and two Eν sub-ranges 1.5–4.0 and 4.0–10.0 GeV), hadronic invariant mass W, pπ⁰ invariant mass M(pπ⁰) for two subsamples (W<1.8 GeV and Δ-enriched W<1.4 GeV), and the π⁰ decay-angle distributions cosθ and φ in the pπ⁰ rest frame for the Δ-enriched (W<1.4 GeV) subsample. Antineutrino/other-flavor channels are not part of this paper. Detector: MINERvA tracker (scintillator, CH). Target: per nucleon (hydrocarbon/CH scintillator target; explicit unit cm²/nucleon per Supplement.tex table captions).
